project_info.name: KuandaiManager
project_info.description: 宽带账号台账管理系统 - Android APK

design_system.name: 液面 / Liquid Ledger
design_system.description: 冷调纸白基底 + 磨砂玻璃材质 + 光纤青信号色

build_steps: 1. 安装 JDK 17: brew install openjdk@17
2. 安装 Android SDK: brew install --cask android-commandlinetools
7. APK输出: app/build/outputs/apk/debug/宽带台账管理_v{versionName}_{日期}_b{versionCode}.apk

versioning.build_date_source: providers.exec 调用系统 date，构建期生成 BuildInfo.java
versioning.note: 覆盖安装必须递增 versionCode
